settings.text: That's Why I Discovered Something Extraordinary When Studying Research From French Scientists Examining Children With Hutchinson-Gilford Syndrome - <br class="show-767"> The "Benjamin Button" Disease That Causes Rapid Aging In Children.

settings.repere: Paragraphe · The medical notes from their 2003 study
settings.text: The medical notes from their 2003 study showed these children shared the same symptoms with adults who looked far beyond their years…

settings.repere: Paragraphe · They had massive levels of an aging prot
settings.text: They had massive levels of an aging protein. And this isn't a protein we eat. It's a protein molecule that builds up in our skin cells called Progerin.

settings.repere: Paragraphe · You see, my own research and that of oth
settings.text: You see, my own research and that of others has shown conclusively that Progerin levels are directly correlated with how quickly our skin ages.

settings.repere: Paragraphe · In 2012, the Advances in Dermatology Stu
settings.text: In 2012, the Advances in Dermatology Study showed that exposure to UVA rays from the sun significantly increases the amount of Progerin in our skin, which explains why excessive tanning prematurely ages us.

settings.repere: Paragraphe · And in one of the largest clinical studi
settings.text: And in one of the largest clinical studies ever conducted, 23 women ages 34 to 78 were analyzed for their response to anti-Progerin compounds.

settings.repere: Paragraphe · What the researchers discovered about th
settings.text: What the researchers discovered about these women's skin was shocking.

settings.repere: Paragraphe · Not only did the women's skin become sof
settings.text: Not only did the women's skin become softer, smoother and firmer...

settings.repere: Paragraphe · It looked and felt younger and healthier
settings.text: It looked and felt younger and healthier than it had in years.

settings.repere: Paragraphe · And because the skin cells were now full
settings.text: And because the skin cells were now fully enriched with these anti-Progerin compounds, they had a radiant glow as if they just came back from their honeymoon!

settings.repere: Paragraphe · Women who thought they could never get r
settings.text: Women who thought they could never get rid of aging skin, jowls, or turkey neck without surgery saw dramatic improvements.

settings.repere: Paragraphe · A month later they cried tears of joy, e
settings.text: A month later they cried tears of joy, experiencing the sensation of skin that is smooth...fresh… and youthful once again.

settings.text: Looking at their transformations, I began to notice something that nobody else had seen:
